oracle_audit.meaning: In every audited run (all 30 producer cells, the 6 sampled pairs incl. seeds 9 and 10, block widths 1, 2, 3, 8) both reused quantities equal the direct grams bit for bit at every iteration; narrowing occurs only in the final iteration, so no identity-2 reuse ever followed a narrowing.

identity_proofs.setup: M = B^T D B (symmetric; mblk). Iteration i: V_full (k_full columns) -> optional narrowing to V_i = V_full[:, sel] with W_i = V_i^T M V_i invertible; c1_i = W_i^{-1} (MV_i^T MV_i); c2_i = W_{i-1}^{-1} (MV_{i-1}^T MV_i); V_{i+1,full} = MV_i - V_i c1_i - V_{i-1} c2_i (all with the narrowed V_{i-1}, MV_{i-1}, W_{i-1}^{-1} stored in vp). Arithmetic is exact in F_ell.
identity_proofs.P_and_Q_unconditional: P(i+1): V_i^T M V_{i+1,full} = MV_i^T MV_i - W_i W_i^{-1} MV_i^T MV_i - (V_i^T M V_{i-1}) c2_i = 0 given P(i). Q(i+1): V_{i-1}^T M V_{i+1,full} = MV_{i-1}^T MV_i - (V_{i-1}^T M V_i) c1_i - W_{i-1} W_{i-1}^{-1} pm_i = 0 given P(i) and pm_i exact. Both hold for any column selection of V_{i+1,full} and are independent of narrowing at any iteration.
identity_proofs.identity_1: pm_BLR = rows 0..k_{i-1} of V_full^T M V_full at columns sel_used = V_full^T M V_i = (MV_{i-1} - V_{i-1} c1 - V_{i-2} c2)^T M V_i = MV_{i-1}^T MV_i - c1^T P(i) - c2^T Q(i) = MV_{i-1}^T MV_i exactly, in every path (narrowing anywhere, iteration 1 without V_{i-2}). Row p of V_full corresponds to column p of MV_{i-1}; W_full is symmetric so the row/column orientation is immaterial. The fallback (vpr.k != k_full) is unreachable because V_full of iteration i always has exactly k_{i-1} = vpr.k columns (harmless dead branch).
identity_proofs.identity_2: V_{i,full}^T V_0 = (MV_{i-1})^T V_0 - c1^T (V_{i-1}^T V_0) - c2^T (V_{i-2}^T V_0); the code drops the first term, i.e. it needs V_{i-1}^T M V_0 = 0. For i = 2 that is P(1) and for i = 3 it is Q(2) (unconditional; narrowing at iteration 0 is excluded because v0 keeps all b columns). For i >= 4 it is long-range M-orthogonality, which by V_a^T M V_b = V_{a+1,full}^T M V_{b-1} (b - a >= 3) holds only while no earlier iteration j >= 1 dropped columns U_j with U_j^T M V_{later} != 0. The guard checks only narrowing at iteration 0, so identity 2 is NOT exact in general after a mid-run narrowing (see discrepancies D1). Indices, transposes (c1[p*k_full+r] = c1[p, r] summed over p), the sign (ls2(0, s)), the history (h_vt0/h_k = iterations i-2, i-1; last_c1/last_c2 = c1_{i-1}, c2_{i-1}) and the row selection sel_used are correct. Narrowing at the current iteration itself is exact (full recurrence, then rows sel_used).
identity_proofs.counting: The recurrence uses lm2/la2/ls2 (counted as lmul/ladd by the same global counters as every other mod-ell operation); identity 1 is copies only (uncounted, as copies are in REF). No counted work moves out of block_lanczos: REF - BLR equals the skipped direct grams minus the recurrence exactly in every audited run (lmul and ladd), and in all 17,920 stress calls where identity 2 was exact.

negative_controls_note: MUT_PM (c2 built from a zero MV_{i-1}^T MV_i) loses M-orthogonality and every block_lanczos call returns early (singular narrowed W via sinv()? or the n + 10 iteration cap) before the oracle line is printed, so its oracle counts are 0 and s.bl_iters is 0; it is detected by the comparator (linear algebra failed, 6 DL attempts vs 1). MUT_C2 runs to the normal iteration count with identical s.bl_iters at attempt 1 and is detected both by the oracle (id2_bad > 0) and by the comparator, i.e. an inexact V^T V0 that leaves the iteration count unchanged still changes counted fields.

amendment_1.identity_2_after_guard: With narrowed_any set inside the narrowing block (before vt0 is formed), the recurrence is used at iteration i only if no iteration 0..i narrowed. Then V_j = V_{j,full} for every j <= i, so V_a^T M V_b = V_{a+1}^T M V_{b-1} = ... = 0 for all a < b <= i (each chain step uses an unnarrowed V_{a+1}), in particular V_{i-1}^T M V_0 = 0 and v0 = V_0; and sel_used is the identity. So V_i^T V_0 = -c1^T (V_{i-1}^T V0) - c2^T (V_{i-2}^T V0) exactly, in every path. Once set, the flag stays set and the direct gram is used for the rest of the call. The guard is conservative: it also uses the direct gram in the narrowing iteration itself, where the recurrence was still exact; that is the whole BLR1 - BLR difference.
